Included are triumphs and disasters alike - as well as Academy Award nominations and prizes. Each entry is accompanied by a photograph of the star at the height of his or her career or in a typical role. Both the old and the new of cinema are found within these pages: Bette Davis William Powell, Marlene Dietrich, John Wayne, Carole Lombard, Richard Burton, Clint Eastwood, Robert De Niro, Robin Williams, Winona Ryder, Kevin Costner, and Christopher Walken, among hundreds of others. From the obscure (Gloria Talbott) to the mega-famous (Tom Cruise), from the award winners (Tom Hanks) to the never nominated (Edward G. Robinson), from the classics (Buster Keaton) to the luminaries of today (Jim Carrey) - the careers of all are here.

title: THE HEART OF MID-LOTHIAN
description: THE HEART OF MID-LOTHIAN BY SIR WALTER SCOTT, BART. TALES OF MY LANDLORD COLLECTED AND ARRANGED BY JEDEDIAH CLEISHBOTHAM, SCHOOLMASTER AND PARISH CLERK OF GANDERCLEUGH. Hear, Land o' Cakes and brither Scots, Frae Maidenkirk to Johnny Groat's, If there's a hole in a' your coats, I rede ye tent it; A chiel's amang you takin' notes, An' faith he'll prent it!---=Burns.= Ahora bien, dijo el Cura: traedme, senor hu sped, aquesos libros, que los quiero ver. Que me place, respondi el; y entrando en su aposento, saco d l una maletilla vieja cerrada con una cadenilla, y abri ndola, hall en ella tres libros grandes y unos papeles de muy buena letra escritos de mano.---=Don Quixote.= Parte I. Capitulo 32. TO THE BEST OF PATRONS, A PLEASED AND INDULGENT READER JEDEDIAH CLEISHBOTHAM WISHES HEALTH, AND INCREASE, AND CONTENTMENT. Courteous Reader, If ingratitude comprehendeth every vice, surely so foul a stain worst of all beseemeth him whose life has been devoted to instructing youth in virtue and in humane letters. Therefore have I chosen, in this prolegomenon, to unload my burden of thanks at thy feet, for the favour with which thou last kindly entertained the Tales of my Landlord. Certes, if thou hast chuckled over their factious and festivous descriptions, or hadst thy mind filled with pleasure at the strange and pleasant turns of fortune which they record, verily, I have also simpered when I beheld a second storey with attics, that has arisen on the basis of my small domicile at Gandercleugh, the walls having been aforehand pronounced by Deacon Barrow to be capable of enduring such an elevation. Nor has it been without delectation that I have endued a new coat (snuff-brown, and with metal buttons), having all nether garments corresponding thereto. We do therefore lie, in respect of each other, under a reciprocation of benefits, whereof those received by me being the most solid (in respect that a new house and a new coat are better than a new tale and an old song), it is meet that my gratitude should be expressed with the louder voice and more preponderating vehemence. And how should it be so expressed? ---Certainly not in words only, but in act and deed. It is with this sole purpose, and disclaiming all intention of purchasing that pendicle or poffle of land called the Carlinescroft, lying adjacent to my garden, and measuring seven acres, three roods, and four perches, that I have committed to the eyes of those who thought well of the former tomes, these four additional volumes of the Tales of my Landlord. Not * [The Heart of Mid-Lothian was originally published in 4 vols.] the less, if Peter Prayfort be minded to sell the said poffle, it is at his own choice to say so; and, peradventure, he may meet with a purchaser: unless (gentle reader) the pleasing pourtraictures of Peter Pattieson, now given unto thee in particular, and unto the public in general, shall have lost their favour in thine eyes, whereof I am no way distrustful. And so much confidence do I repose in thy continued favour, that, should thy lawful occasions call thee to the town of Gandercleugh, a place frequented by most at one time or other in their lives, I will enrich thine eyes with a sight of those precious manuscripts whence thou hast derived so much delectation, thy nose with a snuff from my mull, and thy palate with a dram from my bottle of strong waters, called by the learned of Gandercleugh, the Dominie's Dribble o' Drink. It is there, O highly esteemed and beloved reader, thou wilt be able to bear testimony, through the medium of thine own senses, against the children of vanity, who have sought to identify thy friend and servant with I know not what inditer of vain fables; who hath cumbered the world with his devices, but shrunken from the responsibility thereof. Truly, this hath been well termed a generation hard of faith; since what can a man do to assert his property in a printed tome, saving to put his name in the title-page thereof, with his description, or designation, as the lawyers term it, and place of abode? Of a surety I would have such sceptics consider how they themselves would brook to have their works ascribed to others, their names and professions imputed as forgeries, and their very existence brought into question; even although, peradventure, it may be it is of little consequence to any but themselves, not only whether they are living or dead, but even whether they ever lived or no. Yet have my maligners carried their uncharitable censures still farther.

title: Videohound's Golden Movie Retriever, 1995
description: The media is mad about the Hound and his mad, insightful movie reviews. This 1995 collection lists more than 23,000 movies on video (1,000 new to this edition), full videographies for 26,000 stars, over 4,000 music videos, contact information for 400 distributors, and includes videographies of 5,000 screenwriters and composers.

title: Plowing Through Love
subtitle: A Second Chance Enemies-to-Lovers Slow-Burn Romance Packed with Redemption, Forced Proximity, and Heartwarming Chemistry
description: When your fiercest rival becomes your closest ally, how does competition end and love begin? I never planned to rebuild my farm with him. Miles Miller-the man who's always been my competition, the one person who knows exactly how to push my buttons. For years, we've battled for the same land, the same titles, and the same approval from a community that barely tolerates change. But when sabotage left my dreams in shambles, Miles wasn't the one standing back to gloat. He was the one showing up with a hammer, a plan, and that maddening grin that makes me want to scream-or kiss him. Our truce was meant to be temporary, just long enough to survive the Harvest Festival. But working side by side with Miles reveals a man I didn't expect-a protector, a partner, someone who makes me question everything I thought I wanted. Every stolen glance and lingering touch pulls me closer to a choice I'm terrified to make: to trust him with not just my farm, but my heart. As secrets unravel and the festival stakes grow higher, our fragile partnership teeters on the edge of something deeper. But when the truth about the sabotage threatens to destroy us both, I'll have to decide whether the future I've always fought for is worth risking it all-for him. A heartwarming rivals-to-lovers romance filled with forced proximity, slow-burn chemistry, redemption, and second chances.

title: Movies on TV and Videocassette
description: With over 14,000 listings, from the latest box-office smashes, this updated, 30th Anniversary edition of the definitive movie guide packs more information than any weekly guide in one volume. Includes concise plot summaries, a four-star ratings system, reviews, and more. And, as a bonus, order the 12-copy prepack and pay for only 11 books! A $71.40 retail value.

title: Hate Me Tonight
subtitle: A Steamy Enemies-to-Lovers Contemporary Romance (Rivals, Slow Burn, Forced Proximity)
description: When a high-powered corporate acquisitions manager is forced to co-inherit a quaint, failing bookstore with the owner's fiercely protective grandson-her professional arch-nemesis-they must abide by a crazy clause in the will: work together to save the store for six months or lose it forever. I can't stand him. He's arrogant, infuriating, and my sworn rival. The last thing I expected? To be stuck working with him-every day, every hour, every breath reminding me why I can't stand his smirk... and why my pulse races when he's near. He's the man I promised I'd never fall for. The one who knows exactly how to push my buttons. But when late-night arguments turn into stolen glances, and heated fights spark something undeniable, I start to wonder... What if hate was only the beginning? Hate Me Tonight is a steamy enemies-to-lovers contemporary romance filled with witty banter, fiery tension, and the slow-burn passion that readers will devour. Perfect for fans of forced proximity, rivals-to-lovers, and unforgettable happily-ever-afters.

title: Extra Credit
subtitle: Clean Contemporary Romance
description: They were rivals at seventeen. Now they're colleagues—and neither of them is ready for what's coming. Charlotte Black left Fernbrook chasing her mother's dreams instead of her own. Now she's back—an award-winning psychologist hired to help the students of The Northern Swan cope with the crushing pressure of excellence. Benedict Sterling never left. He built his life teaching at the school where he and Charlotte first clashed as teenagers, carrying a fifteen-year grudge over the night she walked out and left him to face the science fair alone. Forced to work together, they discover the people they were at seventeen are still very much alive beneath the surface. So are the things they never said. With toxic parents determined to interfere, office politics threatening everything they've built, and a lifetime of pride standing between them, Charlotte and Benedict must decide whether their rivalry left any room for something far more dangerous. A slow-burn enemies-to-lovers romance set in the heart of England's stunning Lake District. Perfect for fans of workplace romance, childhood rivals, and love stories worth waiting for. NOTE: This book was previously published as the Science Fair Trilogy (Dating Hypothesis, Dating Experiment, and Dating Conclusion) Join Daisy's Newsletter for updates on new releases, sales, and all things romance and cozy mystery at www.daisylandishromance.com.

title: Icebound Hearts
subtitle: An Emotional MM Hockey Romance for Readers Who Love Rival Teammates, Small-Town Secrets, Forced Proximity, and Two Men Learning to Trust Again
description: Some rivalries never truly end. They only wait for the moment when two people are forced to face each other again. Icebound Hearts is a slow-burn MM hockey romance about rivalry, guilt, second chances, and the unexpected way love can grow when two men are trapped together with their past. Carter Reed once believed the ice belonged to him. Fast, fearless, and hungry to prove himself, he left his small hometown to chase a bigger hockey career. But after years of setbacks, Carter returns home carrying unfinished business and a reputation shaped by rumors he can’t escape. Luka Marin never left. Quiet, disciplined, and almost impossible to score against, Luka became the town’s steady goalie and the player everyone trusts. But behind his calm control is a history filled with hard choices, family sacrifice, and a night that changed everything between him and Carter. Years ago, a fight on the ice ended with their mentor badly injured and the town whispering about blame. Now fate pushes them back into the same rink. A winter tournament brings Carter home. A blizzard traps the players inside the arena. And two rivals who have spent years avoiding the truth suddenly have nowhere left to run. As days pass in the snowed-in rink, tension slowly changes into something neither of them expected. Long nights, shared work, quiet conversations, and the rhythm of the game begin to break the walls they built around themselves. But small towns remember everything. Old rumors return. The town watches their every move. And both men must decide whether holding onto anger is easier than risking something real. If you love emotional MM hockey romance with slow-burn chemistry, forced proximity, and enemies-to-lovers tension, this story offers a heartfelt journey about forgiveness, trust, and finding love where you least expect it. Inside this emotional LGBTQ sports romance, you’ll find: • A slow-burn gay hockey romance • Enemies-to-lovers tension between rival players • Snowed-in forced proximity during a winter storm • Small-town secrets and second chances • Deep character growth and emotional connection This story is for readers who enjoy thoughtful MM sports romance where relationships grow through quiet moments, honesty, and the courage to face the past. Because sometimes the hardest battles aren’t played on the ice. Sometimes they happen in the heart.

title: The Devil's Map
subtitle: A Rivals-to-Lovers Treasure Hunt Romance
description: A stolen map. A vanished mission. A truth that was buried on purpose. Isla Verano makes maps for a living. Not the romantic kind. The kind that keep museums honest and historians from embarrassing themselves. So when she finds a hand-drawn colonial map tucked inside a misfiled archive box, she knows two things fast: The mission marked on it does not exist in any official record. Someone went to work making sure it never would. She barely has time to photograph the ink before the map disappears. Taken by Rafe Calder, a smooth-talking artifact hunter with a reputation Isla has spent her career warning people about. He calls it a rescue. Isla calls it theft. The argument lasts right up until armed men step into the museum with the kind of calm that says they are not there to negotiate. Rafe tells her a billionaire collector named Victor Armand has been buying relics with money and muscle, and this mission is next. If Armand reaches it first, the evidence goes into a private vault and the story stays dead. If Isla wants the truth preserved, she has to come now. Isla would rather be anywhere than in a cramped plane headed toward a jungle airstrip with a man she does not trust. She likes rules. Rafe treats rules like suggestions. She wants proof. Rafe wants them alive long enough to argue later. They follow the map through smuggler routes and river crossings that do not show up on any tourist brochure, chased by mercenaries who move like they have done this before. Isla starts noticing what Rafe does not say. Rafe starts noticing what Isla refuses to admit. The deeper they go, the clearer it becomes that the mission is not hiding treasure. It is hiding a record. Names. What happened. Who made it disappear. And why someone is willing to pay to keep it that way. Rivalry is easy when you have distance. In the jungle, distance is a luxury. When exhaustion strips the masks off and danger forces decisions, Isla and Rafe begin to see each other clearly, not as labels, not as warnings, not as headlines. Then they find the worst proof of all. They were never racing for the mission. They were being guided to it. The Devil's Map is a fast, cinematic treasure hunt romance with sharp banter, real stakes, and a slow-burn relationship built under pressure. No explicit content, just tension, heat, and the kind of choices that change who you are when you walk back out.

title: After Hours on Campus
subtitle: A Spicy Enemies-to-Lovers College Romance
description: He got the research grant she spent eleven months writing. She will absolutely not be professional about this. Nora Calloway is a third-year doctoral candidate, three published papers, 4.0 GPA, and a research proposal that should have won the Holbrook Fellowship. She did not. Declan Marsh — ten weeks in the department, one paper in Nature Geoscience, aggressively clean desk — did. And now the university has decided that the most efficient use of everyone's time is to force them to partner on the project that could define both their careers. This is fine. Everything is fine. After Hours on Campus: A Spicy Enemies-to-Lovers College Romance is the new adult romance for everyone who has ever hated someone they respect a little too much — and late nights in the lab with a person like that have a way of getting very complicated, very fast. Inside After Hours on Campus, you will discover: A research rivals enemies-to-lovers dynamic so electric it practically has its own grant proposal A heroine who is terrifyingly competent and absolutely refusing to admit that Declan Marsh is also terrifyingly competent A 3AM study session, a department conference, one hotel, and a minibar — none of which go the way anyone planned The slow, devastating shift from "I could destroy him" to "I cannot stop thinking about him" Academic banter and genuine intellectual tension between two people who are evenly matched in every possible way A spicy, slow-burn romance with heat that earns every chapter of tension it takes to get there Real emotional depth beneath the competition — what happens when two people who are very good at being right have to figure out what they actually want A satisfying HEA built on mutual respect, publication credits, and something considerably warmer They are very bad at pretending they want to destroy each other. They are even worse at pretending they want anything else. Pick up After Hours on Campus today. Class is in session.

title: White Empire
description: I’m his new trainee, and he has one rule: no dating employees. Sick of working for my parents in our small town, I apply for a traineeship in the city. While waiting at the airport, on a high from nailing my job interview, I meet James, a tall, handsome businessman who comments on my glass of Champagne. His charisma and dark eyes have me feeling all hot and bothered. I catch my flight home and think I’d never see him again… But when I arrive on my first day as a trainee, I bump into him and I’m blushing again. It isn’t until I meet the new CEO and find out it’s…Him. My plan is to focus on the program and not get distracted by him—it’s forbidden. But when he takes time out to teach me when I get stuck with a project and encourages my newly found independence, my attraction for him grows stronger. One night we cross a line, making it impossible for me to deny my feelings. Now, where does that leave me? Do I choose work or love?

title: Doctor Taylor
subtitle: A Billionaire Office Romance
description: Doctor Mike Taylor. The tall, dark, and oh-so-sexy older man was meant to be a one-night fling. Not my new boss. I finally graduated with my nursing degree, and it’s time to celebrate. Out with my friends, I come across the man of my dreams. A long look across the dance floor resulted in a scorching hot kiss. I left that night ready to focus on my new career. But a few months later, when I walk into the biggest hospital in Chicago I meet the new surgeon I’ll be working with. Imagine my surprise to find it’s…him. His piercing blue eyes have my heart beating wildly again. He’s about to become the forbidden fruit I see every day. I wonder if I’ll be able to resist another taste of him. Doctor Taylor is Book One in The Chicago Doctors Series. It's a steamy doctor romance meets forbidden attraction in this sizzling tale of passion and unexpected connections. After a scorching one-night kiss with the tall, dark, and sexy Doctor Mike Taylor, she’s ready to move on and focus on her nursing career. But when she starts her new job at a top Chicago hospital, she’s stunned to discover he’s not just a random fling—he’s now her new boss. His piercing blue eyes and commanding presence make him the forbidden fruit she’s desperate to resist. Will she be able to keep things professional, or will their undeniable chemistry lead them into dangerous territory? Perfect for fans of enemies to lovers, doctor/employee romance, and forbidden office love stories. title: To Sway A Rival
description: A low stakes rival to lovers, hybrid vampires, and friendly dragons fantasy romance Two determined thieves, and a quest through a dragon filled forest. The Stonehearts and the Heathrow family have been rivals for generations. It's not just their thieving guilds that are in competition, but it started when one of their ancestors, no one can remember which one, outsmarted and completed a job that belonged to another. Since then, the families have been competing at times in the most trivial things. They even have their homes right across the street from each other to keep each other in check. So, when Morai falls for Luka, she decides not to tell her family. In fact, she doesn't even tell Luka. She just needs to pull off one last job, then she'll have enough funds to open her own guild. She'll be free to love whoever she wants. But to pull off the heist, she'll have to outwit her rival. Luka Heathrow is a good thief. But the one treasure he can't seem to steal is Morai's heart. He can't just tell her he loves her. As the first born, he has a responsibility to his family; he's destined to take over the family guild. What's more, if anyone finds out he has healing magic he'll be carted off to the temple of Rapha, never to experience the outside world again. No matter that it feels impossible, Luka can't seem to let Morai go. So, when she tries to steal an elixir from the mage tower, he thwarts her plans. But thieving inside one's own city is illegal, and as punishment, the head mage sends Morai and Luka on a wild quest. Trekking through a magical forest filled with dragons, and a plethora of magical creatures, Morai and Luka must work together to secure a rare ingredient for the mage. Will they finally be honest with each other? And, why does it seem like the forest is breathing, literally. To Sway A Rival is Book Nine in the Tempting Thieves Collection. Tempting Thieves is a diverse multi-author romantasy collection featuring cunning thieves who outsmart relentless hunters, steal forbidden treasures, and find love along the way. With enemies-to-lovers tension, slow-burn longing, forced proximity, secret identities, only one bed, and grumpy/sunshine dynamics, every story delivers an irresistible fantasy escape. Perfect for fans of forbidden romance, morally gray heroes, daring rogues, and clean yet sizzling chemistry. Each book in the collection is a standalone. Read in any order.

title: Objecting to Her
subtitle: A Lesbian Romance
description: When law school rivals are forced together, fierce competitors go from enemies to something even more intense in this steamy slow burn. Ari Vidal is starting her dream job as a prosecutor in Miami. After three years of competing with Sloane Medina in law school, she's ready to shine on her own. When Sloane unexpectedly starts working at the same office, Ari's plans are shattered, and she discovers old rivalries die hard. Sloane expected to be working at a prestigious Manhattan law firm, but she's trapped in Miami instead. As if things couldn't get any worse, Ari, who insists on constantly competing with her, is back in her orbit. Thrown together, the women find themselves back at each other's throats. But, despite their best efforts to remain enemies, their relationship changes when they start to see beyond each other's icy exteriors. Passions burn hot enough to melt glaciers in this addictive clash between two strong women who have more in common than they realize. The only question is . . . can they get out of their own way?

title: The Merger Clause
subtitle: A Rivals to Lovers Billionaire Romance
description: Warning / Disclaimer This book is intended for mature audiences only. The Merger Clause contains: 1. Strong language 2. Mature romantic themes 3. Intense emotional conflict 4. Psychological tension 5. Power imbalance dynamics 6. Possessive behavior 7. Corporate manipulation and betrayal 8. Explicit or suggestive romantic scenes 9. Emotional trauma and morally gray characters This is a work of fiction intended for entertainment purposes only. The relationships, actions, and behaviors depicted in this novel should not be considered models for healthy real-life relationships. Reader discretion is advised. The Merger Clause is a dangerously addictive billionaire romance filled with power, obsession, corporate warfare, and a love story forged in fire. Clara Vance built her reputation from the ground up. Cold. Brilliant. Untouchable. In the ruthless world of billion-dollar negotiations, people call her the Steel Orchid—beautiful on the surface, deadly underneath. As the youngest executive to dominate the international mergers market, Clara has spent years proving she belongs in rooms controlled by powerful men who underestimated her. She doesn’t believe in weakness. She doesn’t believe in love. And she definitely doesn’t believe in happily ever after. Then she meets Adrian Thorne. Adrian is the enigmatic billionaire CEO of Thorne Global Holdings, a corporate empire feared across continents. Ruthless in business and impossible to read, Adrian is known for destroying competitors with a smile and rebuilding industries in his image. To the public, he is a visionary genius. To his enemies, he is a predator in a tailored suit. To Clara, he becomes the one man capable of dismantling every wall she has ever built. What begins as a hostile business negotiation quickly transforms into something far more dangerous. Forced into a high-stakes merger that neither side can escape, Clara and Adrian find themselves trapped in a relentless battle of intelligence, pride, and attraction. Every meeting becomes a war zone. Every conversation hides a threat. Every touch feels like a betrayal waiting to happen. But beneath the luxury penthouses, private jets, and billion-dollar contracts lies a darker truth. The merger is hiding secrets powerful enough to destroy careers, families, and lives. As corporate conspiracies begin to surface, Clara realizes that someone inside the company is manipulating the deal from the shadows. Trust becomes impossible. Alliances shift overnight. Rivals become lovers. Lovers become enemies. And the closer Clara gets to Adrian, the more dangerous he becomes. Because Adrian Thorne has secrets of his own. Secrets about the merger. Secrets about Clara. And secrets about the obsession growing between them. Their chemistry is explosive from the very first encounter—sharp dialogue, forbidden attraction, emotional tension, and slow-burning desire that threatens to consume them both. Adrian pushes Clara beyond her limits, challenging the icy control she has spent her entire life perfecting. Clara refuses to surrender, even as she finds herself drawn deeper into Adrian’s world of wealth, power, and emotional darkness. In a world where billion-dollar contracts determine the fate of nations, emotions become liabilities. Love becomes leverage. And vulnerability can destroy everything. As enemies circle closer and betrayal erupts inside the company, Clara must decide whether Adrian is the only man who can save her… or the man destined to ruin her forever. Perfect for fans of: Enemies-to-lovers romance Billionaire romance Corporate power struggles Morally gray heroes Strong female protagonists Forced proximity Dark emotional tension Slow-burn chemistry Luxury, danger, and obsession High-stakes contemporary romance The Merger Clause delivers a cinematic reading experience packed with emotional intensity, seductive tension, sharp banter, shocking twists, and unforgettable characters. It explores the thin line between ambition and obsession, love and control, trust and manipulation. This is not a soft fairytale romance. It is a story about two powerful people colliding at full speed—and discovering that the most dangerous negotiations are the ones involving the heart. Fans of modern billionaire romance and emotionally charged contemporary fiction will be pulled into a world of wealth, betrayal, passion, and psychological tension where every chapter raises the stakes higher. Because some contracts are written in ink. And some are written in desire.

title: For the Record
subtitle: Escape into a heartfelt rivals to lovers romance wrapped in music, chemistry and a second chance at love

But behind the scenes, their simmering tension grew into something more - until suddenly both bands fell apart, and the idea of Mackenzie and Sam did, too. Two years later, Sam has traded the rockstar lifestyle for a quiet life raising the son he didn't know about. Meanwhile, Mackenzie is dealing with a post-operative change in her voice by only singing under a pseudonym. The only way to revive their public careers? A joint comeback album. With fans over the moon and their futures on the line, Sam and Mackenzie face their biggest challenge yet: giving up the old rivalry and learning to work together. But as old sparks fly and new secrets emerge, they set off a chain reaction neither of them could have anticipated - one that proves that sometimes, the greatest hits are the ones yet to be written. subtitle: A rivals-to-lovers romance by the bestselling author of the Artefacts of Ouranos Series

Teetering on the edge of burnout, Tris is stunned when she's picked to attend WMC's corporate leadership retreat in Hawaii. It's a chance to revive her stalled career and compete for a coveted spot in an executive training program - plus, three weeks in paradise! The only downside? Rafe is her co-attendee. Tris plans to avoid Rafe entirely, but when she arrives in Maui, a booking error has them stuck sharing the honeymoon suite - with only one bed . . . Sure, it's not all torture. Rafe is a smoldering ten - okay fine, an eleven - but after years of competition, they can barely stand being in the same time zone. As they vie against each other during aptitude tests and team-building exercises, Tris begins to realize Rafe might not be the villain after all. title: Riding the Storm
subtitle: A Snowbound Second-Chance Romance
description: When a blinding winter storm forces Rowan Carter and Jessa Hale together in Kingsburg, old wounds resurface-and so do long-buried feelings. Once best friends turned estranged, they now face the town, the weather, and each other as they navigate misunderstandings, small-town gossip, and undeniable attraction. Assigned to co-lead the Winter Sports Festival preparations, Rowan and Jessa can't avoid one another-but can they survive the tension, jealousy, and sparks that fly when they're forced to work side by side? From snowbound cabins to heart-stopping blizzards, their slow-burn romance is tested at every turn. As secrets are revealed and courage is found, Rowan and Jessa must decide if love is worth the risk-and if the storms of the past can truly be left behind. A heartwarming, slow-burn winter romance about second chances, holiday magic, and finding love where it was always meant to be. Expect laughter, swoons, and small-town charm. Readers who love enemies-to-lovers, winter wonderlands, and slow-burn romances won't want to miss this final installment of the Winter Rivals Romance Series!

title: PENALTY BOX HEARTS
subtitle: A Dark Suspense Romance
description: What happens when your biggest rival becomes the one person you can't stop thinking about? You've seen the headlines. You've watched the clips. But you don't know what really happened between Kit Chen and Blake Dorsey — not the version the cameras caught, and not the version that played out in empty rinks, bad weather, and late-night texts that had nothing to do with any campaign. Penalty Box Hearts is the rivals-to-lovers dark suspense romance that proves the most dangerous game isn't played on ice — it's played with your heart. Kit has spent years building a career on discipline and image. She's polished, professional, and completely in control. Blake is everything she isn't — aggressive, unpredictable, and somehow always one step ahead. When a brand campaign forces them together for six weeks, Kit tells herself it's business. Blake tells herself the same lie. But something is already cracking. In Penalty Box Hearts, you'll experience: Two rivals forced into close quarters — and what neither of them expected to find A slow-burn tension so thick you'll feel every charged silence and stolen glance A dangerous third party who wants to use their connection to burn everything down Characters who are flawed, fierce, and impossible not to root for A romance that earns every moment — no shortcuts, no easy answers This is not a soft love story. Penalty Box Hearts is raw, real, and relentlessly honest about what it costs to let someone see you — truly see you — after you've spent years hiding behind performance. If you've ever built walls to survive and wondered what would happen if someone refused to respect them, this book was written for you. The ice doesn't lie. Neither does this story. Grab your copy of Penalty Box Hearts today and find out what happens when two women stop pretending.

title: Slow Burn
subtitle: An Enemies to Lovers Romance
description: My new neighbor ticks all the right boxes.Tall - check.Muscular - check.Tatted - double check.Until he opens his mouth.Adam is grumpy, rude, and obnoxious as hell.And I really should tell him exactly where he can shove his insults.Instead, I bite my tongue.He intrigues me, and I can't fight the need I have to find out what caused the pain so evident in his dark eyes.Soon the thick, hungry flames surrounding Adam consume me.I should've known better.Because when you play with fire, you're bound to get burned.

title: The Rivals
description: From #1 New York Times bestselling author Vi Keeland comes a sexy enemies-to-lovers standalone. The feud between Sophia Sterling and Weston Lockwood started at the altar. Only neither of them attended the wedding, and the nuptials happened decades before either was born. Their grandfathers were best friends and business partners up until Sophia's grandfather's wedding day, when his bride-to-be blurted out she couldn't marry him because she was also in love with Weston's grandfather. In the end, all three went their separate ways. The grandfathers married other women and became infamous business rivals, and their children carried the feud into the next generation. Sophia and Weston have continued it, too. For the most part, they keep their distance...until the woman who started the feud dies, leaving one of the most valuable hotels in the world to their grandfathers to share. Now Sophia's stuck in that hotel with the man she was born to hate, trying to unravel the mess their families inherited. It doesn't take long for them to be at each other's throats. After all, Weston is everything Sophia hates- tall, smart, cocky, and too gorgeous for his own good. Still, it shouldn't be an issue. Their families are used to being at war. But there's just one problem...every time Weston and Sophia fight, they end up in bed.

title: Road Trip with My Enemy
subtitle: A Road Trip Enemies-to-Lovers Romance
description: Kian Arlow has one rule: never mix emotions with work. So when her boss announces she has to drive from Mumbai to Goa with her office rival, Ayaan Malik, she’s ready to call it the worst idea of the year. She likes plans, control and quiet. He likes chaos, charm and breaking rules. A broken-down car, one small lodge with a single room, late-night secrets on the highway and an almost-kiss on a moonlit beach slowly turn a forced work trip into something much more dangerous—feelings. At the conference, they’re the perfect “power pair” for the company. On the road, they’re two people who can’t pretend to be enemies anymore. When the trip ends, will they go back to being rivals in the office… or admit that somewhere between Mumbai and Goa, they crossed the line from enemies to something real? Road Trip with My Enemy is a sweet, modern travel romance filled with banter, slow-burn tension and a happy ending.

title: He Hates The Way I Tempt Him
subtitle: A Fiery Enemies-to-Lovers Adult Romance
description: He's the golden boy who has everything. I'm the scholarship girl who has everything to lose. And somehow, we can't stay away from each other. When I walk into Advanced Structural Design and steal Archer Hale's favorite seat, I have no idea I've just started a war. He's cold. Arrogant. Infuriatingly brilliant. The heir to a billion-dollar empire who thinks the world exists to serve him. I'm the first-generation college student fighting to keep my scholarship, my dignity, and my sanity intact. We're supposed to be enemies. But then we're forced to partner on a project that could make or break our futures. Late nights in the library turn into stolen glances. Academic rivalry becomes something far more dangerous. And the line between hate and desire blurs until I can't tell which side I'm on anymore. He says I tempt him. Challenge him. Make him want things he shouldn't want. I say he's going to ruin everything I've worked for. We're both right. Because when his father discovers our relationship, he doesn't just disapprove-he wages war. Threatening my scholarship. Sabotaging our work. Forcing Archer to choose between his family's fortune and the girl who makes him feel alive for the first time in his life. Now we're fighting for more than just our grades. We're fighting for us. But what happens when choosing love means losing everything else? He Hates the Way I Tempt Him is a sizzling enemies-to-lovers new adult romance about two people who were never supposed to fall for each other-but couldn't help themselves. Perfect for anyone who loves academic rivals, forbidden romance, and the kind of slow-burn tension that makes you stay up all night reading.

title: The Alchemist of Amblerose
subtitle: A Cozy Romantasy of Potions, Rivals, and Forbidden Magic
description: When disgraced royal alchemist Elara flees the capital, she expects obscurity-not magic gone wrong. Seeking a quiet life, Elara settles in the rain-soaked coastal village of Amblerose, opening a modest potion shop and hoping never to draw attention again. But Amblerose is built on a fractured ley line, and when a strange magical fog rolls in from the sea, the village elders fall into an enchanted sleep-and Elara's peaceful plans unravel. Her only ally is Caspian, a gruff, reclusive herbalist whose success-and skepticism of city alchemy-make him both a rival and a necessity. Forced to work together, the pair must combine modern alchemy and ancient magic to uncover the source of the corruption threatening the town. As secrets surface and danger grows, so does a slow-burning connection neither expected. But Amblerose holds more than hidden magic, and some past mistakes refuse to stay buried. The Alchemist of Amblerose is a cozy romantasy filled with magical mishaps, gentle adventure, village intrigue, and a heartfelt slow-burn romance. Perfect for readers who enjoy whimsical fantasy, rivals-to-partners dynamics, and charming small-town magic with a happily-for-now ending.

title: The Last Page
subtitle: The sexy new enemies-to-lovers rom com from the author of Not In My Book
description: A bookseller with a dream of running her beloved bookstore vs. the owner’s out-of-touch grandson who inherits everything. Game on. Book Lovers meets You've Got Mail in this sweet, sexy romcom from the author of Not in My Book! Ella lives for The Last Page, the beloved New York bookshop where she’s spent most of her adult life. A bookseller of many years, Ella dreams of owning the store someday and just can’t see herself doing anything else. But when the store’s owner, Ben, dies unexpectedly and leaves the shop to his clueless grandson Henry, Ella’s dreams – not to mention her financial future – are in serious jeopardy. When Ella and Henry learn that the store is on the brink of collapse, they must overcome their differences and work together to save The Last Page – and maybe even find their own Happily Ever After. title: Synergy Workplace Romance Collection Volume 1
description: Fall in love with this collection of three laugh-out-loud STEM workplace romances set in the world of high tech. Now - get the first three Synergy Workplace Romance books all in one place! This collection includes - Work with Me, a rivals-to-lovers romcom set in Austin, with a bonus epilogue - Friend Me, a friends-to-lovers romcom set in San Francisco, with a bonus epilogue - Trip Me Up, an opposites-attract, road-trip romcom, with a bonus epilogue Work with Me ALICIA I walk into the most important meeting of my life – the one that’s going to make or break my career – and *he’s* here. The sexy charmer I met in the hailstorm outside. The guy so temptingly tasty I forgot myself, forgot I didn’t do things like that, and asked him out. The worst part? He turned me down. And now he’s here in my meeting. He’s not charming. He’s cranked off. Because of me. Well, guess what? It’s not the first time I’ve made a tech bro cranky. Just because I wear skirts doesn’t mean I’m going to let them think I’m any less of a programmer than they are. And no matter how smart he is, I’m going to show him who’s the boss. It’s me. And there’s no way I’m going to fall for his player ways again. Not when he sends me hilarious apology gifts, not when I teach him to two-step, and certainly not when he kisses me under the stars. Oops. Fall for these two rival programmers in this steamy, slow-burn, laugh-out-loud enemies-to-lovers romantic comedy featuring a straitlaced single mom, a tech genius who hides a secret under a playboy exterior, and way too much tequila. Set in up-and-coming Austin, it’s the first book in the Synergy Workplace Romance series. Friend Me MARLEE Romance novels are my jam. And everyone knows the plucky assistant – that’s me - always charms the billionaire in an office romance. Too bad Cooper Fallon has never read a romance novel. If he had, he’d know that if you take a fake date to a wedding, you’re sure to fall for him. But I forget that when I take my work bestie, Tyler. In fact, after we dance, when he kisses me under the stars, I forget my own name. But there’s no way I’m falling for my friend. Tyler is nerdy and gentle, lets me win at videogames, and gives magical foot rubs. He’d do anything for me. I won’t risk losing my best friend. Besides, Cooper is who I want. Isn’t he? Be enchanted by this slow-burn-to-red-hot, friends-to-lovers, fake-relationship romantic comedy featuring a starry-eyed heroine, a sweet, cinnamon-roll hero, and a pair of cranky cats. Trip Me Up SAM I didn’t mean to bring my dog to my mother’s stuffy fundraiser. Okay, I might have needed the excuse to get back to my artificial intelligence research, but I never meant for Bilbo Baggins to escape. And I really didn’t count on a sexy lumberjack rescuing my lactose-intolerant dog from the Gorgonzola. Then one thing led to another, and Bilbo and I are on the lumberjack’s – Niall’s – book tour, pretending to have written the novel that my research project spat out by mistake. The only thing that’s not pretend is how our clothes fly off every night. Nope, that’s all too real. And even though I insisted on a no-strings fling, the smolder in those hazel eyes means he wants more. Now he’s calling me his muse, and it’s too late to tell him my secret. Because the whole world knows. Fall in love with this opposites-attract, road-trip romantic comedy featuring a geeky heroine, a sexy farmboy writer, and a limelight-stealing dog.

title: The Viscount's Scandalous Affair
subtitle: A Steamy Regency Historical Romance
description: ❤️ SERIES COMPLETE ❤️ 🔥A high-heat, Regency romance about a scandalous secret affair and unexpected love. 🔥 Charlotte Harding has little to expect from life. Orphaned, penniless, and painfully aware that society finds her forgettable, she survives on the charity of kindly relatives. Then she meets the Viscount Stanton—handsome, wealthy, and entirely out of her reach. He barely notices her… until one reckless night changes everything. Charlotte accidentally witnesses the viscount in a secret liaison, and her silence is bought with a single, unforgettable kiss—one that awakens a longing she never dared hope could be fulfilled. And when later, an opportunity presents itself, Charlotte does something truly scandalous: she makes him an offer. 💕 A secret, temporary affair 💔 No promises. No future 🌹 Stolen weeks of pleasure—memories to sustain her through a lifetime of spinsterhood But the viscount soon discovers the quiet, overlooked woman he never noticed is the one he cannot forget. Desire deepens, and both must decide whether society’s rules are worth denying their hearts. The Viscount’s Scandalous Affair is the first book in The Stanton Legacy, a completed Regency romance series. Each book features a full romantic arc, explicit open-door love scenes, and a guaranteed happily ever after. title: English Novel and Prose Narrative
description: The English Novel and Prose Narrative provides an astute, wide-ranging and accessible critical introduction to the English novel and short fiction, and explores the novel's relations to narrative forms such as biography and autobiography. David Amigoni expertly guides readers in methods of narrative analysis and close reading, while stressing the need to place narratives and narrative theories in historical and cultural context. To this end, he traces critical debates about the origins of the novel, domestic realism and romance, the bildungsroman, journalism and mass culture, the experimental novel, postmodernism and postcolonialism. Adopting a case-study approach, the author provides theoretically informed readings of Pamela, Tristram Shandy, Emma, Jane Eyre, The Mill on the Floss, Bleak House, The Spoils of Poynton, Mrs Dalloway and Midnight's Children as well as short stories by Thomas Hardy and Katherine Mansfield. While primarily an introductory guide, the book also offers a distinct approach to the history of novel criticism that will engage readers interested in the genre at all levels.Key Features:* An all-round introduction to the novel in historical, theoretical and critical contexts* Historically and theoretically grounded readings of widely taught novels* Offers ways of approaching biography and autobiography as contributions to working-class writing and women's writing* Traces critical debates that have shaped fictional and non-fictional prose narratives in cultural history

title: Miss Stanton Meets her Match
subtitle: An Age-Gap Enemies-to-Lovers Historical Romance
description: "a gorgeous steamy little gem...It’s just one of those wonderful tales you pick up and read in one straight sitting." ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Goodreads review "WOW, another well written story by this fabulous author... Would strongly recommend to everyone." ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Goodreads review "I enjoyed these characters and the fast paced plot, that fit in with the Stanton family universe. This story had a satisfying happy ever after. Perfect read for a lazy afternoon." ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Goodreads review Isabella Stanton had determined from an early age that the fact of having been born female would not stand in the way of her doing what she desired. Having inherited a substantial estate from her grandfather, she insisted on taking an active role in managing her affairs, including the tenancy of Netherwick Hall, the magnificent mansion on her estate. Enter Silas Wilson, her new tenant, a widower from Manchester with two young children. He was everything that she disliked—brash, ill-mannered and a man who had made his fortune in manufacturing, no doubt on the exploitation of the poor workers in his factories. Isabella despised him on sight. She consoled herself with the knowledge that she would not have to see him again at all once he took residency of Netherwick Hall. In this assessment, she was to be proved entirely wrong... Miss Stanton Meets her Match is a spin-off novella from The Stanton Legacy series. You do not have to have read the other books in the series to enjoy this novella. Set in Victorian England, this book features an age-gap, enemies-to-lovers romance between a young heiress displaying a great deal of prejudice against the proud widowed industrialist who is not of her social class. If you are a fan of Jane Austen's "Pride and Prejudice" or Margaret Gaskell's "North and South" but enjoy some steam in your romance, then this is the book for you.
