description: This commemorative volume on the life and influence of Emanuel Swedenborg (1688-1772) includes a pictoral biography and essays on topics ranging from Swedenborg in the arts and psychology to examinations of his science and descriptions of the places he lived and worked. This is the most comprehensive book about Emanuel Swedenborg in print.

title: Stephen Hawking
subtitle: Remarkable Lives
description: Stephen Hawking was diagnosed with motor neurone disease at the age of 21 and was expected to live for only another two years. He went on to write books and deliver public lectures right up until his death at the age of 76 in 2018. Hawking achieved commercial success with several works of popular science in which he discusses his own theories and cosmology in general. His book A Brief History of Time, a layman's guide to cosmology, appeared on the Sunday Times best-seller list for a record-breaking 237 weeks and sold more than 10 million copies. As Martin Rees, the cosmologist, astronomer royal and Hawking's longtime colleague wrote, "His name will live in the annals of science; millions have had their cosmic horizons widened by his best-selling books; and even more, around the world, have been inspired by a unique example of achievement against all the odds — a manifestation of amazing willpower and determination." In this concise and informative guide to Hawking's life and work, his key scientific achievements – from gravitational singularities to quantum cosmology – are covered in an approachable and accessible way. This is a celebration of an icon of modern physics, who inspired generations of scientists and changed our understanding of the universe.

title: Brilliant Blunders : from Darwin to Einstein - Colossal Mistakes by Great Scientists that Changed Our Understanding of Life and the Universe
description: This book describes how five famous scientists actually made major errors in the interpretation of their data and how the further investigations of these mistakes led to scientific breakthroughs in such disciplines as biology, medicine, and cosmology. Drawing on the lives of these five great scientists: CXharles Darwin, William Thomson (Lord Kelvin), Linus Pauling, Fred Hoyle, and Albert Einstein, the author shows how even the greatest scientists made major mistakes and how science built on these errors to achieve breakthroughs, especially into the evolution of life and the universe.

title: Brilliant Blunders
subtitle: From Darwin to Einstein - Colossal Mistakes by Great Scientists that Changed Our Understanding of Life and the Universe
description: "Drawing on the lives of five great scientists -- Charles Darwin, William Thomson (Lord Kelvin), Linus Pauling, Fred Hoyle and Albert Einstein -- scientist/author Mario Livio shows how even the greatest scientists made major mistakes and how science built on these errors to achieve breakthroughs, especially into the evolution of life and the universe"--

title: Einstein's Cosmos
subtitle: How Albert Einstein's Vision Transformed Our Understanding of Space and Time
description: Few figures loom as large as Albert Einstein in our contemporary culture. It is truly remarkable that a man from such humble beginnings, an unemployed dreamer without a future or a job, who was written off by his professors as a hopeless loser, could to dare to scale the heights he reached. In this enlightening book, Michio Kaku reasseses Einstein's work by centring on his three great theories: special relativity, general relativity and the Unified Field Theory. He first yielded the equation E =mc2 which is now such a fixture in our culture that it is practically a ubiquitous slogan. But the subsequent theories led to the Big Bang theory, and have changed irrevocably the way we perceive time and space. Michio Kaku offers a new, refreshing look at the pioneering work of Einstein, giving a more accurate portrayal of his enduring legacy than previous biographies. As today's advanced physicists continue their search to fulfil Einstein's most cherished dream, a 'theory of everything', he is recognised as a prophet who set the agenda for modern physics.

title: The True Story of Erwin Schrödinger
subtitle: A Comprehensive Biography of the Austrian-Irish Theoretical Physicist Renowned for His Groundbreaking Contributions to Quantum Theory
description: What if the smallest things in the universe could exist in two places at once? What if a cat could be both dead and alive at the same time? Welcome to the strange world of Erwin Schrödinger-one of the boldest minds in science history. This is not just a story about equations and theories. This is the incredible life journey of a man who forever changed the way we see reality. In this book, you'll discover how a quiet boy from Austria grew up to become a Nobel Prize-winning scientist whose ideas still shape our world. From quantum physics to the mysteries of life itself, Schrödinger pushed the boundaries of what we know and dared to ask what lies beyond. You'll walk through his highs and lows-his struggles, his genius, and the wild imagination that led to one of the most famous thought experiments in history: Schrödinger's Cat. But he didn't stop there. Schrödinger dove deep into the questions of life, mind, and meaning-mixing science with philosophy in ways that still leave people speechless. What Did Schrödinger Contribute? The Schrödinger Equation - The foundation of quantum wave mechanics Schrödinger's Cat - A famous thought experiment that challenges our view of reality What Is Life? - A groundbreaking book that inspired early genetics research Mind and Matter - Writings that explored consciousness and the connection between mind and science Views on Eastern Philosophy - Deep reflections influenced by Indian philosophy and the idea of unity of all things Statistical Thermodynamics - Work that advanced our understanding of the behavior of particles at the microscopic level Whether you're a science lover, a curious thinker, or someone who just wants to understand how the universe really works-this book is for you.

title: Albert Einstein and Sir Arthur Eddington
description: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY: GENERAL INTEREST (CHILDREN'S / TEENAGE). Albert Einstein and Sir Arthur Eddington takes a look at the scientific partnership that changed our understanding of the universe. It explores the early work of both men including Einstein's Theory of Relativity and his famous equation E=MC2, how Eddington was instrumental in helping to prove Einstein's theories, and how his support helped the great Einstein bring his brilliant theories to fruition. How have some of the most successful scientific pairings in history changed the advancement of science and led to discoveries that might never otherwise have been made? Dynamic Duos explores the fascinating scientific partnerships between some of the world's leading scientists. From Darwin and Wallace to Einstein and Eddington, without these 'dynamic pairings' some of the most spectacular discoveries and critical theories in the history of science might never have been made. Ages 9+

title: The True Story of Niels Bohr
subtitle: An In-depth Biography of the Danish Theoretical Physicist Renowned for His Pioneering Work on Atomic Structure and the Development of Quantum Theory
description: Step into the world of one of history's greatest scientific minds. Niels Bohr wasn't just a physicist; he was a pioneer whose groundbreaking discoveries reshaped our understanding of the universe. With his work on atomic structure and the birth of quantum theory, Bohr unlocked the mysteries of the atom and changed the course of science forever. But his story isn't just about formulas and equations-it's about a man who challenged the very foundations of reality, questioned what we thought we knew, and left an indelible mark on physics and philosophy. In The True Story of Niels Bohr, you'll dive deep into the life of this brilliant and complex figure. From his early days in Copenhagen to his rise as a leader in the scientific revolution, this biography takes you through Bohr's triumphs and struggles, his groundbreaking theories, and his ethical reflections on the power of science. Learn about the pivotal moments that shaped his career, the relationships with other iconic physicists, and the personal choices that defined his legacy. This isn't just the story of a man who changed science-it's a tale of curiosity, resilience, and the relentless pursuit of truth. Niels Bohr's influence stretches far beyond the walls of laboratories and classrooms, continuing to inspire generations of scientists, philosophers, and thinkers alike. Now, it's your turn to discover the man behind the theories. Embark on this journey through one of the most exciting and transformative periods in scientific history. The True Story of Niels Bohr is a must-read for anyone who wants to understand the forces that shaped our modern world. Don't wait-uncover the secrets of the universe and the mind that helped reveal them. Read Niels Bohr's true story today!

title: The Big Picture
subtitle: On the Origins of Life, Meaning, and the Universe Itself
description: The instant New York Times bestseller about humanity's place in the universe—and how we understand it. “Vivid...impressive....Splendidly informative.”—The New York Times “Succeeds spectacularly.”—Science “A tour de force.”—Salon Already internationally acclaimed for his elegant, lucid writing on the most challenging notions in modern physics, Sean Carroll is emerging as one of the greatest humanist thinkers of his generation as he brings his extraordinary intellect to bear not only on Higgs bosons and extra dimensions but now also on our deepest personal questions: Where are we? Who are we? Are our emotions, our beliefs, and our hopes and dreams ultimately meaningless out there in the void? Do human purpose and meaning fit into a scientific worldview? In short chapters filled with intriguing historical anecdotes, personal asides, and rigorous exposition, readers learn the difference between how the world works at the quantum level, the cosmic level, and the human level—and then how each connects to the other. Carroll's presentation of the principles that have guided the scientific revolution from Darwin and Einstein to the origins of life, consciousness, and the universe is dazzlingly unique. Carroll shows how an avalanche of discoveries in the past few hundred years has changed our world and what really matters to us. Our lives are dwarfed like never before by the immensity of space and time, but they are redeemed by our capacity to comprehend it and give it meaning. The Big Picture is an unprecedented scientific worldview, a tour de force that will sit on shelves alongside the works of Stephen Hawking, Carl Sagan, Daniel Dennett, and E. O. Wilson for years to come.

title: Relativity
subtitle: The Special and General Theory
description: Delve into the groundbreaking theory that reshaped our understanding of the universe with Albert Einstein's "Relativity: The Special and General Theory." This seminal work, a cornerstone of modern physics, provides an accessible exploration of Einstein's revolutionary concepts of special and general relativity. Einstein elucidates the intricate relationship between space and time, offering insights into gravity, motion, and the very fabric of reality. Discover how these theories redefined our perception of the cosmos, impacting fields from astrophysics to cosmology. This meticulously prepared print edition allows readers to engage directly with Einstein's original explanations, providing a clear and concise introduction to relativity for anyone curious about the fundamental laws governing our universe. Explore the science that forever changed our understanding of space-time and solidified Einstein's legacy as one of history's most influential thinkers. A timeless classic for anyone interested in the history of science and the profound implications of relativity. This work has been selected by scholars as being culturally important, and is part of the knowledge base of civilization as we know it. This work is in the public domain in the United States of America, and possibly other nations. Within the United States, you may freely copy and distribute this work, as no entity (individual or corporate) has a copyright on the body of the work. Scholars believe, and we concur, that this work is important enough to be preserved, reproduced, and made generally available to the public. We appreciate your support of the preservation process, and thank you for being an important part of keeping this knowledge alive and relevant.

title: The Equation that Couldn't be Solved
subtitle: How Mathematical Genius Discovered the Language of Symmetry
description: Mathematical symmetry is thought to be much too difficult for most laypeople to understand but this engaging book approaches it in an elegantly entertaining way. The title's formula is the "quintic" equation (involving x raised to the fifth power), the analysis of which gave rise to "group theory," the mathematical apparatus scientists use to explore symmetry. A leading astrophysicist Livio keeps the science flowing with digressions into human interest (e.g., the founder of group theory, Evariste Galois, was a revolutionary firebrand who died in 1832 at age 20 in a duel over "an infamous coquette"), pop psychology (women have more orgasms when their partners have symmetrical faces), and strategies for finding a soul mate, as well as appreciations of art and music.

title: Enrico Fermi
subtitle: The Obedient Genius
description: This biography explores the life and career of the Italian physicist Enrico Fermi, which is also the story of thirty years that transformed physics and forever changed our understanding of matter and the universe: nuclear physics and elementary particle physics were born, nuclear fission was discovered, the Manhattan Project was developed, the atomic bombs were dropped, and the era of “big science” began.It would be impossible to capture the full essence of this revolutionary period without first understanding Fermi, without whom it would not have been possible. Enrico Fermi: The Obedient Genius attempts to shed light on all aspects of Fermi’s life - his work, motivation, influences, achievements, and personal thoughts - beginning with the publication of his first paper in 1921 through his death in 1954. During this time, Fermi demonstrated that he was indeed following in the footsteps of Galileo, excelling in his work both theoretically and experimentally by deepening our understanding of the Pauli exclusion principle, winning the Nobel Prize for his discovery of the fundamental properties of slow neutrons, developing the theory of beta decay, building the first nuclear reactor, and playing a central role in the development of the atomic bomb. Interwoven with this fascinating story, the book details the major developments in physics and provides the necessary background material to fully appreciate the dramatic changes that were taking place. Also included are appendices that provide a timeline of Fermi’s life, several primary source documents from the period, and an extensive bibliography. This book will enlighten anyone interested in Fermi’s work or the scientific events that led to the physics revolution of the first half of the twentieth century.

title: Theories From Notable Scientist : The Special and General Theory/My Inventions: The Autobiography of Nikola Tesla(Set of 2 Books)
subtitle: Scientific Marvels: Einstein's Theory and Tesla's Ingenuity
description: Theories from Notable Scientist: The Special and General Theory / My Inventions: The Autobiography of Nikola Tesla (Set of 2 Books) The Special and General Theory by Albert Einstein: In this groundbreaking work, Albert Einstein presents his revolutionary theories of relativity. Exploring the nature of time, space, and gravity, Einstein's special and general theories reshaped our understanding of the universe. This book offers readers an opportunity to delve into the mind of one of the greatest scientific thinkers in history and witness the birth of modern physics. My Inventions: The Autobiography of Nikola Tesla: In this captivating autobiography, Nikola Tesla, the enigmatic genius and inventor, shares the story of his life and his brilliant inventions that transformed the world. From his pioneering work in electricity to his vision of wireless communication, Tesla's mind was a wellspring of innovation. Through his words, readers gain insight into the mind of a visionary scientist and his quest to shape the future through his remarkable inventions. Meta Biography: The set of two books, "The Special and General Theory" by Albert Einstein and "My Inventions: The Autobiography of Nikola Tesla," brings together the remarkable theories and life stories of two of the most notable scientists in history. Albert Einstein: Albert Einstein, born on March 14, 1879, was a German-born theoretical physicist who became synonymous with genius. His theory of relativity, including the famous equation E=mc², revolutionized modern physics and earned him the Nobel Prize in Physics in 1921. Einstein's passion for understanding the universe led to significant contributions in quantum mechanics and cosmology. His theories continue to inspire and shape scientific discoveries to this day. Nikola Tesla: Nikola Tesla, born on July 10, 1856, was a Serbian-American inventor and engineer. Often called the "Wizard of Electrical Engineering," Tesla was responsible for the alternating current (AC) electrical system and numerous other groundbreaking inventions. His vision of wireless technology and his experiments with electricity laid the foundation for modern power distribution and communication systems. Tesla's innovative spirit and dedication to science left an enduring legacy on the world. The Special and General Theory / My Inventions: The Autobiography of Nikola Tesla (Set of 2 Books) presents a unique opportunity for readers to explore the scientific theories and personal journeys of two exceptional minds who changed the course of human knowledge and progress.

title: Einstein: Beyond Relativity
subtitle: A Biography Exploring Einstein's Life, Works, and Influence on Modern Physics
description: 🌟 "Einstein: Beyond Relativity" 🌌 - Dive into the mind of Albert Einstein, a name synonymous with genius and innovation. This comprehensive biography, meticulously crafted, explores the full spectrum of Einstein's influence in physics and beyond. 🔭 Discover the man behind the theories that reshaped our understanding of the universe. From his early years to his monumental "Annus Mirabilis" papers, this book delves into Einstein's journey, his struggles, and the mentors who influenced him. Witness the evolution of a visionary physicist who challenged and changed our perceptions of space, time, and energy. 🌐 But there's more to Einstein than just relativity! Uncover his contributions to quantum theory, his philosophical insights, and his role as a public intellectual and humanitarian. "Einstein: Beyond Relativity" transcends the boundaries of science, delving into Einstein's views on politics, global issues, and his enduring legacy in modern physics. 📚 Packed with detailed analysis, engaging narrative, and a deep understanding of Einstein's work, this book is not just a biography; it's an exploration of how one man's ideas continue to shape our world and the future of science. A must-read for anyone fascinated by the life and mind of one of history's most brilliant individuals.

title: Sir Isaac Newton
description: Born in 1642, Sir Isaac Newton is famous for creating the foundations of modern science and our understanding of how the universe works. Newton's remarkable range of discoveries include gravity, the three 'Laws of Motion' that form the basis of modern physics, and a new type of maths called calculus. This book looks at Newton's life and work, and shows how his discoveries both changed society at the time and influenced people in the future.

title: 5 Greatest Scientists of The World
subtitle: 5 Greatest Scientists of the World: Exploring the Legends of Scientific Exploration by Nandini Saraf
description: "5 Greatest Scientists of the World" by Nandini Saraf takes readers on an inspiring journey through the lives and groundbreaking discoveries of five of the most influential scientists in history. From the revelations of Albert Einstein's theory of relativity to the revolutionary work of Marie Curie in the field of radioactivity, Saraf brings to life the monumental achievements of these intellectual giants who reshaped the world as we know it. The book delves into the scientific lives of these extraordinary individuals, highlighting their curiosity, resilience, and passion for understanding the natural world. Each scientist faced tremendous challenges, often going against the accepted knowledge of their time, but their unwavering dedication and visionary ideas changed the course of history forever. As we explore the stories of their struggles, triumphs, and enduring legacies, it becomes clear that science is not just a pursuit of knowledge—it is a grand adventure in uncovering the mysteries of existence. Through Saraf’s engaging narrative, readers gain insight into the minds of these trailblazers and their contributions to science, which still influence our daily lives. Whether it's Einstein's work on the fabric of space-time, James Watt's improvements to the steam engine, or Marie Curie's pioneering research in radioactivity, this book highlights the profound impact these scientists had on technology, medicine, and our understanding of the universe. "5 Greatest Scientists of the World" serves as both a tribute to the remarkable achievements of these individuals and an inspiration for those interested in the endless possibilities that scientific inquiry can offer. Saraf’s ability to convey complex scientific ideas in an accessible and compelling way makes this book a must-read for science enthusiasts, students, and anyone fascinated by the brilliant minds that changed the world. ***** “A captivating and insightful exploration of the lives and legacies of the greatest minds in science. Nandini Saraf brings together inspiring stories that not only educate but also motivate readers to appreciate the power of scientific discovery and the people behind it.” ***** “This book offers a great introduction to some of history’s most influential scientists. Saraf presents their stories in an engaging and accessible way, though I would have liked a bit more detail on their personal lives. Still, it’s an enjoyable read for anyone interested in science and history.” ***** “An informative and enjoyable read! Nandini Saraf does an excellent job of bringing the lives of these five scientific legends to life, making their contributions feel both relevant and inspiring. Some sections could have been more in-depth, but overall, this is a solid overview of their achievements.” ***** “While the book provides a broad look at some of the most important scientists, it feels a bit surface-level at times. I was hoping for a more deep dive into their personal struggles and scientific processes. Still, it’s a good introduction for beginners in science history.” ***** “An interesting read with great potential. While the stories of these scientists are inspiring, I felt the writing could have explored more of the scientific aspects of their work in detail. It’s a good starting point for readers new to these figures, but more depth would have made it even better.”

title: From Newton to Einstein
subtitle: Changing Conceptions of the Universe
description: FROM THE PREFACE: "Einstein's contributions to our ideas of time and space, and to our knowledge of the universe in general, are of so momentous a nature, that they easily take their place among the two or three greatest achievements of the twentieth century. This little book attempts to give, in popular form, an account of this work."The text of this addition focuses on the contributions of the two scientists (born 237 years apart) to our understanding of the gravitation phenomenon and to the role played by Einstein's formulation of his theory of relativity. In a format eminently accessible to the curious modern reader, Harrow offers the a glimpse of two particular moments in a timeline of scientific discovery. As the author states: With the knowledge existing in Newton's day Newton could have done no more than he did; no mortal could have done more. But since Newton's day physics-and science in general-has advanced in great strides, and Einstein can interpret present-day knowledge in the same masterful fashion that Newton could in his day. With more facts to build upon, Einstein's law of gravitation is more universal than Newton's; it really includes Newton's.

title: The True Story of Galileo Galilei
subtitle: An In-depth Biography of the Italian[a] Astronomer, Physicist, and Engineer-often Regarded as a Polymath-highlighting His Groundbreaking Inventions and Personal Life
description: What if one man's curiosity could change the course of history forever? Galileo Galilei, an Italian astronomer, physicist, and engineer, did just that. In The True Story of Galileo Galilei, dive deep into the life of the man who revolutionized science and challenged the very foundations of knowledge. Known for his groundbreaking inventions, such as the improved telescope, and for his daring discoveries-like the moons of Jupiter and the phases of Venus-Galileo didn't just look at the stars. He transformed the way we see the world. This captivating biography takes you on a journey through Galileo's incredible life-from his early years in Pisa to his daring clashes with the powerful Catholic Church. His unwavering commitment to scientific truth, despite facing intense opposition and personal sacrifice, demonstrates the courage needed to challenge established ideas. His work laid the foundation for modern physics and astronomy, influencing generations of thinkers, including Isaac Newton. Galileo's exploration of motion, mechanics, and light changed the way we understand everything from falling objects to the very universe itself. But this book is more than just a chronicle of scientific achievement. The True Story of Galileo Galilei delves into his personal life, exploring his struggles, triumphs, and the passion that fueled his relentless pursuit of knowledge. Galileo's journey is a story of resilience, faith, and the search for truth-lessons that continue to inspire us today. Prepare to be inspired by a polymath who, with his telescope, his genius, and his unshakable belief in discovery, changed the world. Now, it's time for you to look at the stars and uncover the true story of Galileo Galilei. Get your copy today and see how one man's legacy shaped our understanding of science, history, and the human spirit.

title: Alexander A Friedmann
subtitle: The Man who Made the Universe Expand
authors: Eduard A. Tropp|Viktor Ya. Frenkel|Artur D. Chernin
description: Our universe can be described mathematically by a simple model developed in 1922 at Petrograd (St. Petersburg) by Alexander Friedmann (1888-1925). Without the benefit of observational evidence, Friedmann predicted that the whole universe would expand and evolve with time. This astonishing prediction was confirmed seven years later by Edwin Hubble. Its originator, unfortunately didn't live to savor this triumph. This vivid biography of an outstanding scientist sets his life and work against a wide backdrop of the history of cosmological studies and its major players, such as Einstein and others. The book is a window on Friedmann's school and university years, military service, and teaching and research during a seminal period of Soviet history. The authors include unique archival material, such as Friedmann's letters from the Russian Front, as well as contemporary records and reminiscences of colleagues. There is a detailed treatment of his work in theoretical cosmology (1922-1924), set in the context of the organization of Soviet science at the time.

title: The Greatest Story Ever Told... So Far
description: In the beginning there was light but more than this, there was gravity. After that, all hell broke loose... This is how the story of the greatest intellectual adventure in history should be introduced - how humanity reached its current understanding of the universe, one that is far removed from the realm of everyday experience. Krauss connects the world we know with the invisible world all around us, which is removed from intuition and direct sensation. He explains our current understanding of nature and the struggle to construct the greatest theoretical edifice ever assembled, the Standard Model of Particle Physics -- and then to understand its implications for our existence. Writing in the critically acclaimed style of A Universe from Nothing, Krauss celebrates the beauty and wonders of the natural world and details our place within it and how this shapes our understanding of it. Krauss makes this story accessible through profiles of the scientists responsible for these advances, and clear explanations of their discoveries. Krauss takes us on a tour of science and the brilliant personalities who shaped it, often against political and religious indoctrination, enduring persecution and ostracism. Krauss creates a captivating blend of research and narrative to invite us into the lives and minds of these figures,creating a landmark work of scientific history.

title: Trailblazers: Stephen Hawking
subtitle: A Life Beyond Limits
description: Bring history home and meet some of the world's greatest game changers! Get inspired by the true story of a famous scientist who changed our understanding of physics forever. This biography series is for kids who loved Who Was? and are ready for the next level. In 1974, Stephen Hawking shook the world of physics. His theory on black holes went against everything the science community accepted as fact. How did he make such revolutionary discoveries? From a childhood spent building model airplanes to recognition as one of the greatest scientists of his time, Stephen's genius and endless curiosity powered his work. Find out how this boy who loved science became one of history's greatest trailblazers! Trailblazers is a biography series that celebrates the lives of amazing pioneers, past and present, from all over the world. Get inspired by more Trailblazers: Neil Armstrong, Jackie Robinson, Jane Goodall, Harriet Tubman, Albert Einstein, Beyoncé, and Simone Biles. What kind of trail will you blaze?
publisher: Random House Books for Young Readers

title: Overcoming Addiction for Black Women
subtitle: Empowerment, Healing, and Resilience Strategies for Black Women in Overcoming Addiction and Reclaiming Their Lives
description: Step into a transformative path of healing with Overcoming Addiction for Black Women. This empowering guide offers a culturally sensitive and deeply supportive approach to breaking free from the grip of addiction, addressing the unique challenges Black women face, and reclaiming a life of purpose, strength, and joy. About the Book: Overcoming Addiction for Black Women is a compassionate and practical guide written specifically for Black women navigating addiction recovery. Drawing from expert advice, personal testimonies, and culturally relevant strategies, this book provides the tools needed to overcome substance dependency while addressing the societal pressures, systemic injustices, and cultural stigmas that may impact the journey. With its focus on holistic wellness, self-love, and community support, this guide is a beacon of hope and empowerment. Key Features: Understanding Addiction Through a Cultural Lens: Explore the unique challenges Black women face in addiction and recovery. Healing from Trauma and Systemic Pressures: Gain insights into how societal and historical factors contribute to addiction and ways to heal from these wounds. Practical Recovery Strategies: Learn effective techniques for overcoming cravings, managing triggers, and maintaining sobriety. Building a Support System: Discover how to cultivate a network of allies, mentors, and loved ones who uplift and empower your journey. Holistic Wellness Practices: Embrace tools such as mindfulness, nutrition, and self-care to support lasting recovery. Why Choose This Book? Overcoming Addiction for Black Women is a groundbreaking resource tailored to the specific needs of Black women. It combines actionable strategies with cultural sensitivity, providing a safe and empowering space to navigate recovery with confidence and dignity. Who Should Read This Book? Black Women Seeking Guidance in Addiction Recovery Counselors and Advocates Supporting Black Women in Healing Friends and Family Members of Women in Recovery Educators and Activists Addressing Addiction in Black Communities Anyone Committed to Empowering Black Women in Recovery Begin your journey to healing and empowerment with Overcoming Addiction for Black Women.

title: Struggle to Success : 100 Inspirational Stories That Will Ignite Your Passion
description: In the realm of human experience, there exists a profound power that can ignite the spark of determination, transform obstacles into opportunities, and propel individuals toward greatness. It is the power of motivation—the force that drives us to pursue our dreams, overcome adversity, and emerge stronger and more resilient than before. Within the pages of this book, you will embark on a remarkable journey—a journey that unveils the lives of 100 extraordinary individuals who defied the limitations imposed upon them by circumstance, defied the skeptics and naysayers, and rose above the trials and tribulations that threatened to extinguish their dreams. These stories transcend time, culture, and background, representing a tapestry of human resilience and unwavering belief in the face of immense challenges. They offer a glimpse into the lives of trailblazers, visionaries, and unsung heroes who have left an indelible mark on the world. As you delve into these pages, you will encounter individuals whose stories have resonated with millions, capturing the essence of what it means to persevere and achieve greatness. From the triumphs of artists, entrepreneurs, scientists, and athletes to the courage and compassion of activists, humanitarians, and everyday heroes, this collection brings together a diverse tapestry of motivation, inspiration, and empowerment. Through the sheer power of determination, these individuals have shattered barriers, conquered self-doubt, and transformed their dreams into reality. Their stories will awaken the fire within you, ignite your passion, and remind you that anything is possible when the human spirit is unwavering. As you navigate through these stories, prepare to be moved, uplifted, and motivated. Witness the relentless pursuit of knowledge, as individuals like Albert Einstein and Marie Curie challenge the boundaries of human understanding. Marvel at the audacity of dreamers like Walt Disney and Steve Jobs, who dared to imagine new worlds and revolutionize entire industries. And be inspired by the courage of activists like Nelson Mandela and Rosa Parks, who fought against injustice and ignited change on a global scale. But above all, these stories remind us that motivation is not an external force that simply happens to us; it is a flame that flickers within, waiting to be unleashed. Each story serves as a testament to the power of the human spirit and the extraordinary heights that can be reached through unwavering determination and resilience. So, as you embark on this journey of inspiration, open your heart and mind to the transformative power of these stories. Let them ignite your ambitions, fuel your aspirations, and empower you to believe that you too can overcome any obstacle, achieve your dreams, and make a lasting impact on the world. For within these pages lies the blueprint for unlocking your inner potential and embarking on your extraordinary journey. Embrace the stories of these remarkable individuals, for they are not merely tales of accomplishment; they are beacons of hope, guiding you toward a future filled with limitless possibilities.

title: Resilience in Action
subtitle: Inspiring Stories of Triumph
description: Table of Contents Introduction Resilience in Action: Inspiring Stories of Triumph OVERCOMING ADVERSITY THROUGH PERSEVERANCE FINDING STRENGTH IN THE FACE OF LOSS FROM GRIEF TO GROWTH: A JOURNEY OF HEALING THRIVING IN THE FACE OF MEN TAL HEALTH CHALLENGES TURNING SETBACKS INTO SUCCESS FROM FAILURE TO FORTUNE: STORIES OF ENTREPRENEURIAL RESILIENCE REBUILDING LIVES: OVERCOMING ADDICTION AND FINDING RECOVERY RESILIENCE IN THE FACE OF PHYSICAL CHALLENGES PUSHING BOUNDARIES: ATHLETES DEFYING PHYSICAL LIMITATIONS LIVING WITH CHRONIC ILLNESS: STORIES OF STRENGTH AND ADAPTATION RESILIENCE IN RELATIONSHIPS AND COMMUNITY REBUILDING TRUST: STORIES OF FORGIVENESS AND REDEMPTION BUILDING RESILIENT COMMUNITIES: COMING TOGETHER IN TIMES OF CRISIS RESILIENCE IN THE FACE OF DISCRIMINATION BREAKING BARRIERS: TRAILBLAZERS IN THE FIGHT FOR EQUALITY RESILIENCE IN THE WORKPLACE: OVERCOMING BIAS AND STEREOTYPES RESILIENCE IN THE FACE OF TRAUMA FROM TRAUMA TO TRIUMPH: STORIES OF HEALING AND RESILIENCE SUPPORTING SURVIVORS: CREATING SAFE SPACES AND COMMUNITIES CULTIVATING RESILIENCE : STRATEGIES FOR PERSONAL GROWTH BUILDI NG A SUPPORT NETWORK: THE POWER OF CONNECTION DEVELOPING EMOTIONAL INTELLIGENCE: NURTURING RESILIENCE FROM WITHIN

title: Laugh Your Way to Happiness
subtitle: The Science of Laughter for Total Well-Being
description: Lesley Lyle presents the surprising scientific evidence that reveals the importance of laughter for our mental and physical health, our prosperity, our relationships, our careers – in fact, every aspect of our lives. Drawing inspiration from Laughter Yoga, a movement founded in India by Dr Madan Kataria that uses laughter and breathing exercises to bring about amazing changes in the health and well-being of thousands of individuals, Lesley reveals: The scientific evidence of laughter's beneficial effects on our health, including lowering blood pressure and improving concentration The emotional aspects of laughter and how it can alleviate anxiety, stress and depression The spiritual aspects of laughter and how it can help provide a sense of connection and wholeness Throughout Lesley reveals how to bring more laughter into your daily life, including practising simple but fun exercises that will help you see opportunities for laughter in the most unexpected places. Laughter can be simulated as an exercise in a group; with eye contact and childlike playfulness, it soon turns into real and contagious laughter. This is a book that will delight, as well as inform – most importantly, it will positively change your life.

title: The Journey Within
subtitle: Unlocking Your True Potential
description: The Journey Within: Unlocking Your True Potential by Prince Penman is your ultimate guide to personal growth and self-discovery. Dive deep into a transformative journey where you'll uncover the keys to self-awareness, resilience, and mindfulness, enabling you to align your life with your true passions and values. Through a compelling blend of practical exercises, real-life stories, and insightful reflections, this book offers you the tools to: Cultivate Self-Awareness: Understand your thoughts, emotions, and behaviors to make informed decisions and build healthier relationships. Embrace Change and Let Go of the Past: Release limiting beliefs and step confidently into new opportunities for growth and development. Develop Emotional Intelligence: Enhance your ability to navigate life's challenges with empathy, resilience, and effective communication. Build a Growth Mindset: Adopt a mindset that empowers you to embrace challenges, learn from setbacks, and continuously seek opportunities for improvement. Foster Mindfulness and Gratitude: Incorporate practices that help you stay present, manage stress, and cultivate a sense of appreciation and contentment. Overcome Fear and Build Resilience: Confront your anxieties and develop the inner strength to persevere through adversity. Packed with actionable strategies and powerful insights, The Journey Within is more than just a book—it's a roadmap to unlocking your true potential and living a more fulfilling, purpose-driven life. Whether you're seeking to enhance your self-awareness, overcome fear, or build a growth mindset, this book is your go-to resource for personal transformation. Embark on your journey within and discover the extraordinary potential that lies within you.

title: Faith and Knowledge to Overcome Chronic Addiction
description: *Includes the gruesome albeit heroic tales of the Early Christian Martyrs, and 20th century martyrdom. This book's meant to target the addict who's fallen so deep within the pits of hell they've ran out of options and require upmost assistance. (the omnipotent source). Yet, it surprisingly relates and opens the eyes of anyone merely suffering from stress or depression; particularly as a cause of our deceptive society we live amongst. This book's far more than a unique and relatable approach at using Christianity, as the author understands many who don't use this path aren't in need of turning in that direction. Thereupon, F&K ft. historic/modern sociology, etc. This book attracts non-believer's unlike anything else. Written by an addict involved in the deepest levels of the life-style for 20years, this book presents an unimaginable variety of sources and topics. The time has come to toss the N/A book straight into the trash. Ft.For the Non-Believers/If God's Not Real: Christian Philosophy vs. Positive Thinking

title: Men’s Sacrifice, Women’s Privilege
subtitle: The Truth About Gender Dynamics
description: Are You Tired of Being Told Men Are the Problem? Do you feel like modern feminism has gone too far? Are you frustrated by the constant narrative that men are oppressors and women are perpetual victims? Do you wonder why men’s sacrifices and struggles are ignored while women’s grievances are amplified? If so, this book is for you. - Discover the historical truth about patriarchy and how it was built on collaboration, not oppression. - Learn why the victimhood narrative harms both men and women, and how it undermines true equality. - Explore the toxic impact of gender wars and why masculinity should be celebrated, not vilified. - Uncover the Marxist roots of modern feminism and how it seeks power, not equality. - Understand the dangers of feminist policies on family structures and societal stability. - See how false empowerment through victimhood creates dependency, not strength. - Examine the moral and societal consequences of the abortion debate, including men’s rights. - Reclaim the value of masculinity and learn how to build healthier, more balanced relationships. If you want to break free from the lies of modern feminism and understand the true dynamics of gender, then buy this book today. It’s time to stop the blame game and start building a society where both men and women can thrive.

title: Shadows of Expectation
subtitle: The Unseen Struggles of School Girls in Modern India
description: In the rapidly evolving world of education, the role of societal expectations on schoolgirls remains a subject of profound importance. The perception that we have made substantial progress in gender equality is a half-truth that overlooks the deeply ingrained cultural, societal, and economic challenges many young girls in India still face today. As I set out to write this book, "Shadows of Expectation: The Unseen Struggles of School Girls in Modern India," my primary aim was to shed light on these often-overlooked narratives—the real, raw stories of girls across different regions of India who, despite the modern age, continue to battle the invisible chains of tradition, expectation, and societal pressure.

title: Until Death: Every Defeat is Psychological
description: In this book, Until Death: Every Defeat is Psychological, we embark on a journey to explore the profound idea that all defeats, be they personal, professional, or existential, are fundamentally psychological. This exploration is rooted in the belief that the narratives we create and the perceptions we hold about ourselves and our world dictate how we experience and overcome challenges. The premise of this book is both simple and revolutionary: the external world may present us with setbacks and failures, but it is our psychological response to these events that truly determines the impact they have on our lives. Defeat, in essence, is not an absolute condition imposed upon us by external forces but a construct of our own making. The stories we tell ourselves about our failures and the meanings we ascribe to them shape our reality more than the events themselves.

title: The System Versus the Law
description: Presents the story of the author's battle to prove his innocence and win his freedom from prison, while overcoming drug addiction and rebuilding his life and family relationships.

title: The Healing Journey Through Addiction
subtitle: Your Journal for Recovery and Self-Renewal
description: TABLE OF CONTENTS: Embarking on Your Journey. A Road Map Through Addiction. Destination: Beyond Denial--Awakening and Acknowledgment. Destination: Understanding Your Addiction. Destination: The Present--The Price You Pay. Destination: Getting Support. Destination: Addiction-Free--The Day You Stop. Destination: Relapse and Slips. Destination: Understanding Emotions. Destination: The Past--Understanding Personal History. Destination: Self-Inventory. Destination: Self-Esteem and Personal Identity. Destination: Understanding Relationships. Destination: Good Health--Rebuilding Body, Mind, and Spirit. Destination: Unfinished Business. Destination: The Future--Maintaining Recovery. As One Journey Ends, Another Begins. Acknowledgments.
publisher: New York ; Toronto : John Wiley & Sons, Incorporated

title: Masters of Management
subtitle: How the Business Gurus and Their Ideas Have Changed the World—for Better and for Worse
description: "A tour de force of management theory . . . An insightful, hard-headed, and amusing guide . . . should be required reading for every student of business." —Lynda Gratton, author of The 100-Year Life In 1996, longtime Economist journalists and editors John Micklethwait and Adrian Wooldridge published The Witch Doctors, an explosive critique of management theory and its legions of evangelists and followers. The book became a bestseller, widely praised by reviewers and devoured by readers confused by the buzzwords and concepts the management "industry" creates. At the time, ideas about "reengineering," "the search for excellence," "quality," and "chaos" both energized and haunted the world of business, just as "the long tail," "black swans," "the tipping point," "the war for talent," and "corporate responsibility" do today. For decades, since the rise of MBA programs on campuses across the country, the field of management has operated in a dubious space. Many of its framers clamor for respect within the academy while making millions of dollars pedaling ideas, some brilliant and some nonsensical, in speeches, consulting arrangements, and books. Although The Witch Doctors was a damning critique ("a scalpel job," according to The Wall Street Journal), it also argued that much of management theory is valuable—making companies more efficient and productive, improving organizational life for workers, and providing sound ways for companies to innovate while defending more entrenched plans. Building upon all that made the original such a phenomenal success. This fully revised and updated edition, Masters of Management, takes into account the rise of the Internet, the growing power of emerging markets, the Great Recession of 2008, and the more recent developments in management theory. The result is an indispensable volume for any manager.

title: Marriage Revolution
subtitle: Rethinking Your Relationship in Light of God's Design
description: The author teaches couples to put Jesus first in their lives and marriage and to apply Christs teachings to their relationships to develop their own revolutionary marriages.

title: Consumer Health Information Source Book
description: How can an award-winning source book that helps consumers find health information be improved? Health expert Alan Rees has done just that in his sixth edition by providing practical advice on using the Internet, tips on where to find Spanish-language health pamphlets, and recommendations on what's most important in the world of alternative medicine. The sixty edition provides users with an annotated guide to health-related resources—hotlines, newsletters, pamphlets, Web sites, CD-ROMS, magazines, books, and more! Readers are given a description on each resource and how to best use it.

title: Standard Catalog for High School Libraries
description: The 1st ed. accompanied by a list of Library of Congress card numbers for books (except fiction, pamphlets, etc.) which are included in the 1st ed. and its supplement, 1926/29.

title: 19th Century European Painting
subtitle: David To Cezanne, Revised Edition
description: This new revised edition of an established survey of 19th century European painting from David through Cézanne includes new chapters with fifteen new illustrations on four notable women artists-- Angelika Kauffmann, Elizabeth Vigée-Lebrun, Berthe Morisot, and Mary Cassatt. This edition also contains further text revisions and updates to the bibliographies. The focus of 19th Century European Painting remains on the important artists and movements of the period with chapters on each artist's life and work, characteristics of style, and the relationship of the artistic movements to historical and intellectual currents of the time.Neoclassicism, Romanticism, Realism, Academics and Salon Painters, and Impressionism are covered and the following artists receive substantial monographic treatment: David and his followers, Goya, Ingres, Géricault, Delacroix, Corot, Courbet, Millet and the Barbizon painters, Manet, Monet, Degas, Renoir, Sisley, Pissarro, and Cézanne. There are 435 illustrations, suggested readings and references, and an index..

title: I Am RecoverED
subtitle: A Simple Story of Overcoming Addiction
description: Create a long-term "high" and find yourself recovered. What is the true purpose of self-help? We live in an era of self-help but we often forget the true purpose behind helping ourselves is more than just achieving our New Year's Resolutions or other personal goals. Everyone has a unique and powerful story that they create daily. We can also play a pivotal role in the story of others. RecoverED is the story of Todd Sylvester, a successful public motivational speaker, and what he has learned during the process of becoming recovered. Dive into these honest and raw stories. In these pages, you will not only experience Todd's journey through depression, addiction, and recovery. You will also follow him on his path of getting clean, finding a purpose in life, and realizing that there was never anything wrong with him. Discover the true, lasting purpose of self-help and embark on your own journey. No matter what your struggle may be or where you're at, now is the perfect time to create a new path in your story.

title: The Only Life I Could Save
subtitle: A Memoir
description: Katherine Ketcham devoted four decades to researching and writing about addiction—but none of that prepared her for what she would face in her relationship with her own son. The Only Life I Could Save is a raw and moving memoir of heartbreak, healing, and profound transformation. “This book is not about Ben and his addiction journey, nor is it about the ‘demon’ that I lived with in my mind for all those years,” she writes. “This book is about the Big Know-It-All Who Realizes She Doesn’t Know a Damn Thing. Except this one daunting truth—the only life I can save is my own.” In these pages, Katherine Ketcham brings you hard-earned wisdom about the impact of addiction on families, the relationship between spirituality and recovery, and what she deems the most important lessons of faith, hope, acceptance, and forgiveness. For parents and siblings, educators and counselors—all of us who have been witness to the disease of addiction—here is a hope-giving book that places special emphasis on the healing side of the story: living in recovery with the support of a loving community.

title: VISION of HOPE
subtitle: Rebuilding a Life Destroyed by Drugs and Alcohol
description: This book chronicles the time before and after a meth fire breaks out in the author's home. It starts with the night of the fire and progresses through all of the barriers she faced to reclaim her life. This includes her time in jail, in treatment, getting her children back and returning to school. She took what others may have deemed the end of their lives and created a future worth staying sober for. One of giving back and helping others to heal.

title: Strung Out
subtitle: One Last Hit and Other Lies That Nearly Killed Me
description: Growing up in LA, Erin Khar hid behind a picture-perfect childhood filled with excellent grades, a popular group of friends and horseback riding. After first experimenting with her grandmother's expired painkillers, Khar started using heroin when she was thirteen. The drug allowed her to escape from pressures to be perfect and suppress all the heavy feelings she couldn't understand. This fiercely honest memoir explores her fifteen-year struggle with addiction and details the various lies she told herself, and others, about her drug use. With enormous heart and wisdom, she shows how the shame and stigma surrounding addiction, which fuels denial and deceit, is so often what keeps addicts from getting help. While there is no one path to recovery, for Khar it was in motherhood that she found the strength and self-forgiveness to quit heroin and fight for her life. Strung Out is a life-affirming story of resilience while also a gripping investigation into the psychology of addiction and why people turn to opioids in the first place.

title: Breaking Free
subtitle: Overcoming Addiction and Building a Life of Sobriety
description: Breaking Free: Overcoming Addiction and Building a Life of Sobriety by Ryan Johnson is a must-read for anyone struggling with addiction or seeking to support someone on the path to recovery. In this powerful and inspiring book, Johnson draws on his own experience of addiction and recovery to provide a roadmap for breaking free from addiction and building a fulfilling life of sobriety. Through his own story, Johnson shows that addiction is not a moral failing or a lack of willpower, but rather a complex disease that requires understanding, compassion, and the right tools to overcome. He shares his journey from a life consumed by addiction to a life of sobriety and purpose, offering insights and guidance for anyone seeking to do the same. Breaking Free is not just a book about overcoming addiction; it is also a guide to building a life of meaning and purpose after addiction. Johnson shares practical strategies for rebuilding relationships, finding fulfilling work, and cultivating healthy habits that support long-term sobriety. He offers a holistic approach to recovery that addresses the physical, emotional, and spiritual dimensions of addiction, helping readers to heal from the inside out. Throughout the book, Johnson emphasizes the importance of community and support in the recovery process. He shows readers how to find and build a support system that will help them stay on track and achieve their goals. He also shares stories of others who have overcome addiction, offering hope and inspiration to those who may be struggling with their own journey. What sets Breaking Free apart from other addiction and recovery books is Johnson's honest and vulnerable storytelling. He shares his darkest moments with authenticity and courage, showing readers that they are not alone in their struggles. He also shares his successes with humility and gratitude, offering a roadmap for how others can achieve the same. If you or someone you know is struggling with addiction, Breaking Free is the book you need to read. It offers a compassionate and practical guide to overcoming addiction and building a life of sobriety that is both fulfilling and meaningful. With Ryan Johnson as your guide, you can break free from addiction and achieve lasting recovery.

title: Life After the Chains
subtitle: How God Rebuilt My Life After Addiction: Living Proof That God Still Restores
description: A Journey Only God Could Write is the raw, honest, and deeply spiritual story of a man who lost everything-and the God who rebuilt his life from the ashes. Through addiction, heartbreak, grief, and moments of complete collapse, Jeremy shares the truth of what it feels like to hit rock bottom and discover that God is still there, even in the darkest places. The book begins with the descent-those painful seasons where life spiraled out of control and hope felt unreachable. Jeremy recounts the breaking points, the shame, the isolation, and the moments when he believed his story was beyond repair. But in the middle of the chaos, God intervened. What follows is a powerful testimony of transformation: learning to live again, rebuilding trust, healing relationships, and discovering a purpose born from pain. As the journey unfolds, Jeremy reveals how freedom is not a single moment but a daily choice-one rooted in honesty, surrender, and God's relentless grace. He shares how redemption reshaped his identity, restored his relationships, and gave him a new life marked by clarity, peace, and purpose. The book closes with a message directly to the reader, an invitation to believe that no life is too broken for God to restore. Through a heartfelt epilogue and a prayer of blessing, Jeremy reminds every reader that their story is not over, that redemption is possible, and that God is still writing new chapters for those who dare to trust Him. A Journey Only God Could Write is more than a memoir-it is a testimony of hope, a roadmap for healing, and a declaration that God can redeem anything. Jeremy's story stands as living proof that no matter how deep the pain or how long the struggle, grace has the final word.

Practical strategies to recognize your triggers and take control before cravings take over. Step-by-step guidance for preparing your recovery plan and setting yourself up for success. Proven techniques to overcome dependency and build resilience for long-term healing. The importance of support networks and how to create a circle of encouragement that keeps you accountable. Relapse prevention strategies to help you stay strong through life's ups and downs. Healthy habits and lifestyle changes that nourish both body and mind. Emotional healing and self-compassion practices to rebuild confidence and self-worth. Maintaining long-term recovery with tools to sustain sobriety, embrace life fully, and thrive beyond addiction. Written in a clear, beginner-friendly style, this book combines expert advice with practical exercises and compassionate guidance. Whether you're just starting your journey or supporting someone you love, Addiction Recovery Therapy for Beginners offers the roadmap to reclaim your life, regain your freedom, and embrace hope for the future. Take control today - your journey toward lasting recovery starts here.

title: Overcoming Drug Addiction.
subtitle: From Rock Bottom to Redemption
description: "Overcoming Drug Addiction: From Rock Bottom to Redemption" is a powerful and deeply human journey through the shadows of addiction into the radiant light of healing and hope. This book speaks to the heart of every person who has ever felt trapped, ashamed, or afraid that change might never come. More than a story of struggle, this is a testimony of triumph. It opens with the raw reality of hitting rock bottom-the breaking point where pain becomes unbearable and denial no longer works. But in that darkest place, something extraordinary begins: a spark of surrender, a flicker of faith, and the courage to rise again. Each chapter walks with the reader through the emotional, spiritual, and physical layers of recovery: confronting trauma, facing withdrawal, finding identity, rebuilding trust, releasing shame, and rediscovering purpose. With soul-deep honesty and unwavering compassion, this book gently reminds you that your worst chapter does not have to be your final one. Whether you're on your recovery path, standing beside a loved one who is, or seeking to understand the journey, this book offers more than insight-it offers hope. It tells the truth without judgment and speaks redemption without condition. It is a reminder that no matter how far you've fallen, you are never beyond the reach of grace. This is not just a story of addiction. It's a resurrection. A guide to rebuilding a life that is sober, whole, and deeply meaningful. A promise that healing is possible and that the future still holds beauty for you.

title: Alive Again
subtitle: Recovering from Alcoholism and Drug Addiction
description: A powerful book on addiction recovery by a doctor who overcame addiction himself, the renowned founder and president of The Hills Treatment Center in Los Angeles Howard Samuels is one of the world's leading drug and alcohol addiction experts who runs the prestigious The Hills Treatment Center in Los Angeles. Decades ago, from the age of sixteen until he was thirty-two, Dr. Samuels had his own intense struggle with addiction to cocaine and heroin. Using his own compelling story as inspiration as well as case studies of his patients from all walks of life, Dr. Samuels shows how readers can recover from alcoholism and drug addiction by following this 12-step program to happiness and fulfillment in sobriety. This self-help book provides hope, inspiration, and prescriptive advice for those who want to recover as well as guidance for friends and family members seeking help for someone they love. Written from the unique perspective of a recovering addict who has helped thousands of people overcome addiction to alcohol and drugs Shares with readers for the first time in book form The Hills' world-renowned treatment program Tells Samuels' personal recovery story as the son of a prominent politician and businessman among the rich and famous in New York and Washington Contains a groundbreaking prescriptive program showing how to work each of the 12 steps Examines the cause of addictions, relapses, and fallback addictions Contains important information for family and friends of those struggling with addiction, including steps for intervention and healing The author appears regularly on TV

title: Poured Me a Glass of Life
subtitle: One Women's Journey of Choosing Life Over the Bottle
description: A real-life portrayal and uplifting memoir of one woman's near-death struggle with alcoholism. Denise beautifully tells her story of where the depths of alcoholism led her, and her inspiring story of finally finding hope and strength to overcome her underlying issues, and no longer needing a substance to numb her life. Going on to work with and navigate thousands of people away from the entrapment and pain that mental health and addiction create, Denise shares not only her story, but the stories of the journeys of a number of her clients. "Poured me a glass of Life" is a journey of life, death, and rebirth. It shares inspirational hope and strength which is thought provoking, keeping you captivated, and profoundly emotionally moved with every single page.

title: Full Circle
subtitle: Memoir of Addiction, Fatherhood, and the Second Chance I Never Deserved
description: Full Circle A Memoir of Addiction, Fatherhood, and the Second Chance I Never Deserved by Jeff Bowers Jeff Bowers took his first drink at thirteen. What followed was a slow, relentless descent into addiction-alcohol, pills, cocaine, meth, and eventually complete collapse. Along the way, he lost trust, relationships, and nearly his life, pushing away the people who mattered most, including his young son. By 2014, Jeff was broken, and out of options. Faced with a choice to keep running or finally surrender, he chose a different path. Full Circle is a raw, unfiltered memoir of addiction and recovery, told without excuses or sugarcoating. Through faith, accountability, and the rooms of Alcoholics Anonymous, Jeff begins the hard work of rebuilding-his sobriety, his family, and his purpose. This is not just a story about getting sober. It's about becoming a father worth following, a man willing to face his past, and a life rebuilt from the ground up. Written with honesty, humility, and hope, Full Circle is for anyone who has fallen, anyone searching for redemption, and anyone who believes second chances are possible-even when they feel undeserved.

title: Loving Myself Back to Life
description: Loving Myself Back to Life This book is a deeply personal and transformative journey of healing, resilience, and rediscovery. It explores what it means to rebuild yourself after years of emotional pain, survival mode, and self-doubt. Through reflection and insight, you guide readers through the process of learning how to truly love themselves—not as a concept, but as a daily practice. The story speaks to those who have felt lost, broken, or disconnected, offering hope that healing is possible no matter how dark the past has been. At its core, the book is about reclaiming your worth, finding strength in vulnerability, and walking the long road back to a life filled with purpose, self-acceptance, and inner peace.

title: Strong in the Broken Places
subtitle: A Memoir of Addiction and Redemption Through Wellness
description: An inspiring memoir about one man's journey to overcome addiction, anxiety, and depression through meditation, yoga, and juicing Quentin Vennie shouldn’t be alive—he has walked a path that many don’t live long enough to write about. Growing up in Baltimore, he was surrounded by nothing but dead ends. Statistics mapped out his future, and he grew hostile toward a world that viewed him with suspicion and disdain. He was shot at, sold drugs up and down the East Coast, lingered on the brink of incarceration, and stared down death more than once. Haunted by feelings of abandonment and resentment, he struggled with chronic anxiety and depression and battled a crippling prescription drug addiction. The day he contemplated taking his life was the day he rediscovered his purpose for living. Vennie’s survival depended upon his finding a new path, but he didn’t know where to turn—his doctor was concerned only with prescribing more medication. Vennie refused, and in a desperate attempt to save his own life, decided to pursue a journey of natural healing. After researching a few self-healing methods, he immediately bought a juicer from an all-night grocery store. He started juicing in the hopes that it would help him repair his body and clear his mind. He jumped headfirst into the world of wellness and started incorporating yoga and meditation into his life. This “wellness trinity” helped him cut back on and then quit the many medications he was on, overcome his addictions, and ultimately, transform his life while inspiring others to find their own unique path to wellness. Strong in the Broken Places is the harrowing story of Vennie’s life, the detours that almost ended it, and the inspiring turns that saved it. The odds were stacked against him, but he was able to defy expectations and claw his way out on his own terms. He is living proof that during our weakest moments, we have the power and ability to unlock unimaginable strength.

title: Addiction to Wholeness
subtitle: A Mind-Body Guide to Healing and Recovery
description: Break free from addiction. Rebuild your life. Rediscover hope. In Addiction and Breaking Free: Journey to Recovery, Grace W. Bauer shares a compassionate and practical guide to overcoming addiction and finding lasting healing. Through honest stories and faith-based insight, she shows that recovery is not just about quitting-it's about rediscovering purpose, peace, and inner strength. Inside, you'll discover: - How to identify the roots of addiction and begin real healing - Steps for rebuilding self-worth, relationships, and balance - The power of forgiveness, faith, and community in recovery Whether you're on your own recovery path or supporting someone you love, this inspiring book offers real hope, encouragement, and the reminder that it's never too late to start again. Your past does not define you-freedom begins today.

title: Finding My Lost Life
subtitle: The Fall to Addiction & Rise to Recovery
description: In Finding My Lost Life: The Fall to Addiction & Rise to Recovery, Jeremy takes readers on a unflinchingly honest journey from the depths of addiction to the triumph of recovery. Battling demons of substance abuse, loss, and despair, Jeremy faced incarceration- a wake-up call that led to an incredible transformation. He gives you a front row seat to all the horrible events that took place. The powerful memoir is not just a story of hitting rock bottom, but rising from it with hope, strength, and a renewed purpose. With raw vulnerability and inspiring insight, Jeremy shares hard-earned wisdom about overcoming addiction, finding inner peace, and building a new life out of the ashes of the old one. Finding My Lost Life: The Fall to Addiction & Rise to Recovery offers hope for anyone who has ever struggled with addiction, been through the justice system, or simply lost their way. It’s a testament to the human spirit’s capacity for change and redemption.

title: Thorn In My Side
subtitle: Forbidden Fruit
description: A gripping, honest, and deeply human memoir about the hidden struggle of porn addiction-and the long, courageous journey to recovery. For years, I lived with a secret that shaped every part of my life. What began as curiosity slowly grew into compulsive pornography use, affecting my confidence, relationships, mental health, and sense of identity. I felt trapped by shame, overwhelmed by fear, and convinced I was alone. This biopic tells the true story of my descent into porn addiction, the impact it had on the people I loved, and the painful turning points that forced me to confront the truth. It is the story of how I reached rock bottom-and how I fought my way back through porn addiction recovery, resilience, and rebuilding. Inside these pages, you'll find: The real emotional and psychological signs of porn addiction How addiction quietly affects the brain, behaviour, and daily life The strain porn addiction puts on relationships The messy, vulnerable stages of overcoming porn addiction What life looks like after breaking free from pornography How healing, accountability, and support can open the door to lasting change This book is not a manual-it's a raw, personal journey through struggle, honesty, and transformation. If you're searching for hope, clarity, understanding, or a powerful true story of addiction and recovery, this memoir offers a voice that many have been afraid to give. Whether you're dealing with internet porn addiction, supporting someone you care about, or simply drawn to stories of redemption, this book shines a light on a topic often kept in the dark-and shows that healing is always possible. Courageous, heartfelt, and inspiring-this is the story of how I rebuilt my life after porn addiction, and how you can begin your own journey toward freedom and self-worth.

title: Addiction
subtitle: The Greatest Thief
description: Addiction: The Greatest Thief is an inspiring and deeply personal narrative of Lameck Mabuka's journey through the darkness of addiction and into the light of redemption. Drawing from his own life experiences, Mabuka sheds light on the silent but destructive power of addiction, which steals potential, distorts purpose, and isolates its victims. Born into a faith-filled but financially struggling family, Mabuka's early life was marked by aspirations of breaking free from poverty. However, his pursuit of quick fixes led him down a path of gambling, alcohol, and substance abuse, starting with peer pressure in high school and escalating in university life. These vices promised relief but left him trapped in cycles of dependency, shame, and failure, stealing his dreams, relationships, and academic progress. The book takes readers on an emotional journey, starting with the allure of temptation and the subtle ways addiction takes root. Mabuka candidly shares the depths of his struggles, including losing his education loan to gambling and alienating those who cared about him. But amidst the darkness, moments of clarity began to emerge. He found strength through the unwavering love of his family, especially his father-a minister who prayed tirelessly for his son's redemption. Faith plays a central role in Mabuka's story. A transformative moment came when a sermon by Dr. Rei Kesis reignited his hope, reminding him of God's grace and the power of surrendering to a higher purpose. With the support of spiritual mentors and the Baraton University Church community, Mabuka embraced baptism and embarked on a journey of recovery. Yet, as Mabuka emphasizes, the road to freedom from addiction is not linear. Relapses and temptations threatened his resolve, but each setback became an opportunity to strengthen his faith and commitment. Through discipline, prayer, and support from his community, he began to reclaim his life, rebuild his relationships, and rediscover his God-given purpose. More than a memoir, Addiction: The Greatest Thief is a guide for anyone struggling with addiction or supporting someone who is. It offers practical lessons, including recognizing the early signs of harmful habits, seeking help without shame, and replacing destructive behaviors with positive ones. Mabuka highlights the importance of self-awareness, faith, and community in overcoming addiction, making this book a beacon of hope for those trapped in similar battles. This powerful testament to resilience and redemption reminds readers that no matter how far they've fallen, recovery and transformation are always within reach. Through vulnerability, courage, and faith, Mabuka's story inspires others to confront their challenges, rediscover their purpose, and live a life of freedom and fulfillment. With its heartfelt storytelling and universal message, Addiction: The Greatest Thief is not just a book-it's a call to hope, healing, and a renewed life.

title: Broken is a Gift
subtitle: A Candid and Revealing True Story of Loss, Addiction, Brokenness, and the Triumphant Return to a Life Worth Living
description: Incarceration to Executive Dr. Michelle Shaivitz shares her journey in her new book, Broken is a Gift. Not just a tale of personal triumph, Broken is a Gift gives readers a blueprint for realizing their own potential. Part personal narrative, part self-help, this book is both engaging and enlightening. Anyone who has ever struggled with just existing from one day to the next will identify with Michelle's personal story. With a beautiful family, nice house, good job and all the things that come with that, Michelle was silently struggling. An alcohol addiction pushed Michelle to rock bottom and landed her in jail. During her struggles and her journey, Michelle realized, sitting in the middle of her cold jail cell that being broken was a gift because it meant she could rebuild herself however she wanted. Today, Michelle leads a local nonprofit organization, appears as a speaker, and provides personal coaching to people interested in living a life they don't want to get away from. After realizing that "You cannot be the captain of your ship if you are also the anchor that is weighing you down," Dr. Shaivitz has made a point of focusing on solutions for change, not just the problems.

Written with expertise, compassion, and clarity, this guide provides a step-by-step roadmap to understanding and overcoming addiction while fostering personal growth and self-awareness. Addiction to pornography and masturbation is a challenge many face but few discuss openly. This book breaks the silence, offering readers practical tools and emotional support to confront the issue head-on. It demystifies the science behind addiction, sheds light on its emotional and psychological impacts, and equips readers with actionable strategies for recovery. With a focus on self-therapy, the book empowers readers to take control of their recovery journey. It is tailored for those who may not have access to professional help or prefer to explore solutions independently. Through insightful explanations, real-life examples, and effective techniques, the guide addresses the root causes of addiction, helping readers replace harmful habits with positive, life-affirming behaviors. This comprehensive guide covers: Understanding Addiction: Explore the science of how compulsive behaviors develop and uncover the myths and misconceptions about pornography and masturbation. Recognizing the Signs: Learn to identify the emotional and behavioral patterns that signal addiction and gain tools to assess your progress. Building a Foundation for Change: Discover the power of self-awareness, set realistic goals, and create a supportive environment for recovery. Practical Recovery Strategies: Master techniques to break the habit loop, manage urges, and develop healthy coping mechanisms.
